description:
Hi, 
 My name is Kunal Saini, I have a requirement from our direct client as below. Please let me know if you are interested in the job and you can contact me @ 631 649 1313 Extn. 7708
 
 Please check the job description below: 
 Title: .Net Developer (Web Engineer) 
 Location: BLYTHEWOOD, South Carolina 
 Duration: 12 months 
 Job ID: 7518-1 
 
 Daily Duties / Responsibilities: 
 Analyze the SCDMV phoenix ii and web applications 
 Take the lead in analyzing and trouble-shooting assigned system problems 
 Propose solutions 
 Code, test, promote, and interact with impacted users ensuring that solution meets requirements. 
 Provide daily and weekly status to the development manager. 
 
 Required skills (rank in order of importance): 
 Microsoft .net architecture and programming 
 MS web service architecture and programming. 
 Business to business web service interface architecture. 
 Web user interface programming 
 WINFORMS 
 Visual studio 2010-2015 
 Vb.net, c++.net, c#.net 
 JavaScript, xml 
 MS internet information systems (IIS) architecture and support. 
 

 Required skills (rank in order of importance): 
 Java
 Web Development (Tapestry, HTML, JavaScript, Jquery)
 Web Services (REST, SOAP, WSDL)
 EDI Transaction Sets (270/271, 276/277, 837)
 ActiveMQ
 SQL and Stored Procedures
 Spring Security
 JDBC
 Unix Environment/scripting
 

 Must have 4 to 6 years of experience with following:
 Ms office 
 .Net
 Web Services
 Web Objects
 VB.Net
 JavaScript
 Web - application programming interface (API)
 Developing Web Application for Heavy Volume Sites
